resources.string: Save your profiles, layout and follows to one file, locked with a passphrase. Keep the file anywhere; without the passphrase nobody can read it.
Choose a passphrase of at least %1$d characters. It is not stored anywhere: if you forget it, the file cannot be opened.
Saved. Keep the file and the passphrase safe.
No backup file found. Put a .shamash file in the TV\'s Download folder or use a TV with a file picker.
Too many wrong tries. Wait %1$d seconds.
It also holds keys and sign-ins.
Merge: add the profiles that are not here
Replace: make this TV match the backup
Replace removes the profiles that are not in the backup. A copy of your current profiles is kept first.
The import failed and nothing was changed.
The passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
This file is too large to be a backup.
This is not a Shamash backup.
This backup is from a newer version of Shamash. Update the app first.
Wrong passphrase, or the file is damaged.
The backup is not valid and was not imported.
